description: This file implements a Debugger class that manages debugging state and interactions for a browser automation context. It includes methods for pausing, resuming, and handling debugging events, as well as managing paused call metadata and determining when to pause.

classes.name: Debugger
classes.description: Manages debugger state, pause/resume control, and event handling within a browser context. Extends EventEmitter and implements instrumentation listener for debugging.

methods.name: setMuted
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the debugger, preventing or allowing pause/resume actions.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken before a call, may trigger pause if conditions are met.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles actions before input, may trigger pause if enabled.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses execution at a specific point, storing call metadata and emitting pause state change event.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution, optionally stepping over the next statement, clearing paused metadata.

methods.name: pauseOnNextStatement
methods.description: Sets the debugger to pause on the next statement.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if the debugger is currently paused, optionally based on specific call metadata.

methods.name: pausedDetails
methods.description: Returns details of currently paused calls, including metadata and associated SDK objects.

methods.name: function shouldPauseOnCall(sdkObject: SdkObject, metadata: CallMetadata): boolean { shouldPauseOnCall
